title: Binance Futures Updates BFUSD Maximum Holding Limits - 2025-01-17
text: This is a general and marketing announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, From  2025-01-17,  Binance Futures will increase the  BFUSD  Maximum Holding Limits for VIP 0 to 9 users as per the table below: VIP level Old Maximum Holding Limit (in BFUSD) New Maximum Holding Limit (in BFUSD) 0 400,000 600,000 1 1,600,000 2,400,000 2 2,400,000 3,600,000 3 3,200,000 4,800,000 4 4,000,000 6,000,000 5 4,800,000 7,200,000 6 5,600,000 8,400,000 7 6,400,000 9,600,000 8 7,200,000 10,800,000 9 8,000,000 12,000,000 Notes: Maximum Holding Limits are independent for each Master or Sub-account.  To monitor more real-time changes in the maximum holding limits, refer to our  Trading Rules . API is supported when purchasing or redeeming BFUSD, but this is only applicable for  Binance   Portfolio Margin users . The API to buy BFUSD: POST /sapi/v1/portfolio/mint The API to redeem BFUSD: POST /sapi/v1/portfolio/redeem Users with virtual Sub-accounts cannot purchase BFUSD. However, users can purchase BFUSD from their Master account and transfer it to their virtual Sub-account through this API: POST /sapi/v1/sub-account/futures/internalTransfer  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
